# Block diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-block/grammar/block.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Block diagram syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `block-beta` and `block`
diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, a sentence generator, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid@12
decides what is valid, this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file
(DESIGN §4.4). One difference is chosen: a label may be a markdown string, which mermaid@12's
grammar rejected (D736).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid@12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF and CR read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read
as `='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with
`style…:…#…;` (or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` entities read as
opaque text that no rule takes apart; and a line break appended. Keywords are case-sensitive.

**Line breaks mean nothing.** Blanks and line breaks only separate tokens, so statements need
no separator: `columns 2 a b` on one line is a `columns` statement and two blocks. An id takes
any character but blanks, `( ) [ ] { } < > - : =`, so `;`, `,`, `.`, `|`, `%`, `#`, quotes and
Unicode are id characters, and an inline `%%` is not a comment. Labels are always quoted, as a
string `"text"` or a markdown string `` "`**text**`" ``.

A block written again merges into the first (its position and span stay). A composite
`block:id … end` or `block … end` holds at least one statement. A span `:n` goes only after the
first block of a statement or a composite header.

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A block diagram is `block-beta` or `block`, then at least one statement.

```ebnf
diagram = BLOCK_DIAGRAM_KEY statement { statement } EOF ;
```

```ebnf
statement = nodeStatement
          | Columns
          | Space
          | Composite
          | ClassDef
          | Class
          | Style ;
```

Blocks joined by edges: `a`, `a["text"]:2`, `a --> b -- "label" --> c`.

```ebnf
nodeStatement = Sized { Edge Block } ;
```

```ebnf
Sized @Block = node [ SIZE ] ;
```

```ebnf
Block @Block = node ;
```

```ebnf
node = NODE_ID [ shape ] ;
```

```ebnf
shape = NODE_DSTART label NODE_DEND
      | BLOCK_ARROW_START label DIR { DIR } BLOCK_ARROW_END ;
```

A label: a string, or a markdown string (D736).

```ebnf
label = STR
      | MD_STR ;
```

```ebnf
Edge @Edge = link ;
```

```ebnf
link = LINK
     | START_LINK LINK_LABEL STR LINK
     | START_LINK MD_STR LINK ;
```

```ebnf
Columns @Columns = COLUMNS ;
```

```ebnf
Space @Space = SPACE_BLOCK ;
```

`block:id … end` (the header may take a label, a span and edges) or `block … end`.

```ebnf
Composite @Composite = id-block node [ SIZE ] { HeaderEdge HeaderBlock } statement { statement } end
                     | BLOCK_DIAGRAM_KEY statement { statement } end ;
```

```ebnf
HeaderEdge @HeaderEdge = link ;
```

```ebnf
HeaderBlock @HeaderBlock = node ;
```

```ebnf
ClassDef @ClassDef = classDef CLASSDEF_ID CLASSDEF_STYLEOPTS ;
```

```ebnf
Class @Class = class CLASSENTITY_IDS STYLECLASS ;
```

```ebnf
Style @Style = style STYLE_ENTITY_IDS STYLE_DEFINITION_DATA ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `string`, `md_string`, `NODE`, `BLOCK_ARROW`, `ARROW_DIR`, `LLABEL`, `CLASSDEF`, `CLASSDEFID`, `CLASS`, `CLASS_STYLE`, `STYLE_STMNT`, `STYLE_DEFINITION`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | BLOCK_DIAGRAM_KEY | `block-beta\b` |  | `block-beta` or `block`: starts a block diagram; inside one, `block … end` is a composite without an id. |
| INITIAL | id-block | `block:` |  | `block:id … end`: a composite, a block holding blocks on its own column grid. The id may take a label and a span, as in `block:g["Group"]:2`. |
| INITIAL | BLOCK_DIAGRAM_KEY | `block\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `[\s]+` |  | Blanks and line breaks separate tokens. |
| INITIAL | COLUMNS | `columns\s+auto\b` |  | `columns n` or `columns auto`: how many columns the level's grid has; the last one wins. |
| INITIAL | COLUMNS | `columns\s+[\d]+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `["][`]` | push(md_string) | A markdown string, as a label in a shape, a block arrow or an edge (D736). |
| md_string | MD_STR | `[^`"]+` |  |  |
| md_string | — | `[`]["]` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `["]` | push(string) | A quoted text: a label, in a shape or an edge. |
| string | — | `["]` | pop |  |
| string | STR | `[^"]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SPACE_BLOCK | `space[:]\d+` |  | `space` or `space:n`: n empty cells of the grid. |
| INITIAL | SPACE_BLOCK | `space\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | DEFAULT | `default\b` |  | Reserved; no statement starts with it. |
| INITIAL | LINKSTYLE | `linkStyle\b` |  | Reserved; block diagrams have no `linkStyle`. |
| INITIAL | INTERPOLATE | `interpolate\b` |  | Reserved. |
| INITIAL | classDef | `classDef\s+` | push(CLASSDEF) | `classDef name styles`: a class of CSS styles, as `classDef hot fill:#f96,stroke:#333`. |
| CLASSDEF | DEFAULT_CLASSDEF_ID | `DEFAULT\s+` | pop push(CLASSDEFID) |  |
| CLASSDEF | CLASSDEF_ID | `\w+\s+` | pop push(CLASSDEFID) |  |
| CLASSDEFID | CLASSDEF_STYLEOPTS | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | class | `class\s+` | push(CLASS) | `class a, b name`: gives the blocks a class. |
| CLASS | CLASSENTITY_IDS | `\w+(?:,\s*\w+)*` | pop push(CLASS_STYLE) |  |
| CLASS_STYLE | STYLECLASS | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | style | `style\s+` | push(STYLE_STMNT) | `style a, b styles`: CSS styles for the blocks, applied after every statement. |
| STYLE_STMNT | STYLE_ENTITY_IDS | `\w+(?:,\s*\w+)*` | pop push(STYLE_DEFINITION) |  |
| STYLE_DEFINITION | STYLE_DEFINITION_DATA | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `accTitle\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | Block diagrams have no `accTitle`; no statement takes it. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `accDescr\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) | Block diagrams have no `accDescr`; no statement takes it. |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `accDescr\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `[\}]` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^\}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | end | `end\b\s*` |  | `end`: closes the innermost composite. |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\(\(\(` | pop | A shape closer; any closer closes any opener, and a pair v12 knows sets the shape. |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\)\)\)` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `[\)]\)` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\}\}` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\}` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\(-` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `-\)` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\(\(` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\]\]` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\(` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\]\)` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\\\]` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\/\]` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\)\]` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `[\)]` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `\]>` | pop |  |
| NODE | NODE_DEND | `[\]]` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `-\)` | push(NODE) | A shape opener, right after a block id: `[` square, `(` round, `((` circle, `(((` double circle, `([` stadium, `[[` subroutine, `[(` cylinder, `{` diamond, `{{` hexagon, `>` odd, `[/` and `[\` lean and trapezoid shapes. |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(-` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\)\)` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\)` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(\(\(` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(\(` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\{\{` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\{` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `>` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(\[` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\(` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[\[` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[\\|` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[\(` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[\\` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[\/` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | NODE_DSTART | `\[` | push(NODE) |  |
| INITIAL | BLOCK_ARROW_START | `<\[` | push(BLOCK_ARROW) | `<["text"]>(right, up)`: a block arrow, pointing in the listed directions. |
| INITIAL | NODE_ID | `[^\(\[\n\-\)\{\}\s\<\>:=]+` |  | A block id. |
| INITIAL | EOF | `$` |  | The end of the text. |
| BLOCK_ARROW | — | `["][`]` | push(md_string) |  |
| NODE | — | `["][`]` | push(md_string) |  |
| NODE | — | `["]` | push(string) |  |
| BLOCK_ARROW | — | `["]` | push(string) |  |
| BLOCK_ARROW | — | `\]>\s*\(` | pop push(ARROW_DIR) |  |
| ARROW_DIR | DIR | `,?\s*right\s*` |  | A block arrow's direction: `right`, `left`, `up`, `down`, `x` (both sides) or `y` (top and bottom), separated by commas. |
| ARROW_DIR | DIR | `,?\s*left\s*` |  |  |
| ARROW_DIR | DIR | `,?\s*x\s*` |  |  |
| ARROW_DIR | DIR | `,?\s*y\s*` |  |  |
| ARROW_DIR | DIR | `,?\s*up\s*` |  |  |
| ARROW_DIR | DIR | `,?\s*down\s*` |  |  |
| ARROW_DIR | BLOCK_ARROW_END | `\)\s*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | LINK | `\s*[xo<]?--+[-xo>]\s*` |  | An edge: `-->`, `---`, `--x`, `--o`, `<-->`, `==>` (thick), `-.->` (dotted) and their kin, with any number of dashes or equals signs. |
| INITIAL | LINK | `\s*[xo<]?==+[=xo>]\s*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | LINK | `\s*[xo<]?-?\.+-[xo>]?\s*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | START_LINK | `\s*[xo<]?--\s*` | push(LLABEL) | The start of a labelled edge, as `a -- "text" --> b`. |
| INITIAL | START_LINK | `\s*[xo<]?==\s*` | push(LLABEL) |  |
| INITIAL | START_LINK | `\s*[xo<]?-\.\s*` | push(LLABEL) |  |
| LLABEL | — | `["][`]` | push(md_string) |  |
| LLABEL | LINK_LABEL | `["]` | push(string) |  |

| INITIAL | SIZE | `:\d+` |  | `:n` after a block: it spans n columns. |
